excerpt: The DELPHI detector at LEP has collected 54 pb^{-1} of data at a centre-of-mass energy around 183 GeV during 1997, 158 pb^{-1} around 189 GeV during 1998, and 187 pb^{-1} between 192 and 200 GeV during 1999. These data were used to measure the average charged particle multiplicity in e+e- -> b bbar
publisher: The DELPHI Collaboration et al. / Phys.Lett.B479:118-128,2000; Erratum-ibid.B492:398,2000
title: Hadronization properties of b quarks compared to light quarks in e+e- -> q qbar from 183 to 200 GeV
